newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Goldtron sees over 15 mln shares crossed.
newsitem.headline: Goldtron sees over 15 mln shares crossed.

text.p: Goldtron Ltd saw a block of 15.278 million shares crossed at Singapore 0.90 each on Friday, dealers said.
They said the market was speculating that Malaysian Mokhzani Bin Mathathir could be accumlating more shares.
At 0821 GMT, Goldtron was up S$0.04 to S$0.945 on 15.746 million shares traded, including the block trade.
On August 12, Mokhzani announced he had bought 15 million Goldtron shares, representing 3.94 percent, at S$0.90 from the company's major shareholder, Ong Soon Kiat.
